prompt: Identify the part with the grammatical error (or 'No error').
sentence: His blonde long hair adds (a)/ glamour to his looks and long beard (b)/ makes him look like a saint. (c)/ No error (d)
options: glamour to his looks and long beard
makes him look like a saint.
explanation: In the adjective order (opinion-size/length-age-colour), length precedes colour. Correct: 'His long blonde hair adds'.
